died.name: John Rogers
died.desc: English clergyman, Bible translator and commentator
died.cause: prior to burning at the stake for heresy

died.name: Franz Reichelt
died.desc: Austro-Hungarian born French tailor and inventor
died.cause: prior to leaping from Eiffel Tower in fatal test of "parachute suit" The 33-year-old tailor and inventor leaped from the Eiffel Tower wearing a parachute made from cloth, his own invention, and fell 57 m to his death. He was asked by friends and authorities to use a dummy for the feat, but declined, saying "I intend to prove the worth of my invention". His impact crater was 15 cm deep.

died.name: Phil Gay
died.desc: captain of fishing trawler Ross Cleveland
died.cause: final radio message before ship sank
died.last_words: I am going over. We are laying over. Help me. I am going over. Give my love and the crew's love to the wives and families.

born.name: Pierre de Bérulle

born.last_words: I do bless.-May Jesus and Mary bless, rule and govern.

born.name: Josiah Quincy III

born.cause: hearing his daughter read to him about Lieutenant Colonel Joseph Bailey saving the Union fleet during the Red River Campaign
born.last_words: That is true glory. I will hear no more.

born.name: Richard Seaman
born.cause: on his deathbed after being fatally burned in a racing crash
born.last_words: I was going too fast for the conditions – it was entirely my own fault – I am sorry.
